value.answer: Mostly overrated, I'd say. It's well made and third-party tested, and most people find it tastes decent. But several blends are underdosed, some key amounts are hidden in proprietary blends, and I couldn't find any independent clinical evidence for its benefit claims. A dietitian at a competing brand called it one of the most expensive all-in-one supplements out there. Don't double up on vitamin A, zinc or niacin, since that can push you over upper limits. If you take blood thinners or blood pressure medication, reishi and grape seed can interact with them, so check with a doctor or pharmacist first. If you like the convenience and can afford it, fine, but it doesn't deliver enough to justify the price.
